name: Way Palm
description: Send a palm along the one clear line that the Way shows through the foe's guard.

name: Way Guard
description: Stand so that every blow must cross open ground first and loses its force on the way.

name: Way Step
description: Take the pace the Way lays out and arrive where no strike was aimed.

name: Way Eye
description: See the clear lines through a crowd or a thicket without searching for them.

name: Way Passing
description: Pass a hand through the guard where nothing obstructs and nudge the target off balance.

name: Way Counter
description: Slip beside a strike on its own line and return it along the same line.

name: Way Clearing
description: Clear a blocked channel in the user or an ally with a long slow breath along the Way.

name: Unobstructed Strike
description: Throw a blow where nothing stands between palm and mark so it arrives at full force.

name: Way Through
description: Find the single line through a thick guard and let the blow follow it ignoring all else.

name: Smooth Palm
description: Strike along the path the field of qi has already cleared in front of the user.

name: Easing Guard
description: Let the field bend each blow along the path of least cost away from the body.

name: Smooth Step
description: Glide down the path the field opens and arrive with no sense of having moved.

name: Smooth Sense
description: Let the field report the easiest path across the ground and where others will take it.

name: Smooth Breath
description: Breathe along the field's path to refill the user's qi at no more cost than the breath.

name: Slack Hand
description: Lay a slack hand on the target and let the field leach the tension from their arm.

name: Smooth Counter
description: Turn a strike down the path it would take if left alone and out of the body's reach.

name: Tao Rinse
description: Rinse a poison from an ally's channels along the easiest path out of the body.

name: Effortless Rend
description: Rend a guard with a single blow that costs the user almost nothing to throw.

name: Yielding Thrust
description: Follow the path of least resistance through a thick guard and strike where it ends.

name: Pairway Palm
description: Strike in time with a partner's yield so the two moves are one blow.

name: Accord Guard
description: Stand with a partner so each covers what the other leaves open.

name: Accord Step
description: Move a pace in step with a partner so they never cross each other's way.

name: Accord Sense
description: Share the sense of the field with a partner so each knows what the other perceives.

name: Twin Yield
description: Yield together with a partner so a blow meant for one slides onto neither.

name: Accord Bind
description: Hold the target between two soft holds that tighten as they resist.

name: Accord Strike
description: Land two blows from either side in one breath so the foe cannot yield to both.

name: Twin Accord
description: Move in full accord with a partner so the strike of the pair spreads over every foe within reach.

name: Levelway Palm
description: Strike with a palm held perfectly level so the force enters the target evenly.

name: Levelway Guard
description: Hold the qi level around the body so a blow spreads out flat and dies.

name: Levelway Step
description: Move without rise or fall so the foe cannot guess when the weight will shift.

name: Levelway Reading
description: Read the field for any place that stands higher or lower than the rest.

name: Levelway Breath
description: Level the user's breath and qi so each move that follows comes smooth and swift.

name: Level Flick
description: Flick a flat bead of qi that flies level to the target's brow.

name: Leveling Touch
description: Touch a foe and bring their raised qi down level with the ground.

name: Quiet Store
description: Settle an ally's qi into a quiet basin so their next moves cost less.

name: Level Counter
description: Meet a strike on level qi and send it back along the plane it came.

name: Levelway Strike
description: Bring the whole level field of qi through one palm in a single flat blow.

name: Calming Wave
description: Spread a calming field over the area until every foe in it loses heat and haste.

name: Taolaw Palm
description: Strike in plain accord with natural law so there is no force in the world that opposes it.

name: Taolaw Guard
description: Stand sworn to natural law and let a blow break upon it as the sea upon a shore.

name: Law Step
description: Step as the world's weights fall and cross the ground without friction.

name: Law Sense
description: Feel where natural law bends around an unseen thing and learn what hides there.

name: Law Binding
description: Hold the target by the weights of the world so that only matching law frees them.

name: Law Counter
description: Turn a strike on the plain law of motion and send it back unchanged.

name: Oath of Ease
description: Swear an oath of ease over the field so that those who break it grow slow and heavy.

name: Law Strike
description: Strike by a law no guard can turn aside unless it is matched by a greater law.

name: Law Unbroken
description: Stand in a shield made of natural law that cannot be broken by any strike that breaks the law.

name: Unwalled Palm
description: Strike with a palm that has no edge to stop at and no wall behind it to answer.

name: Unwalled Wayguard
description: Stand with no wall about the body and let each blow pass through open space.

name: Unwalled Step
description: Cross open ground in unbroken steps that have no turning and no pause.

name: Unwalled Waysense
description: Let the senses run outward with no edge to them and learn the shape of the ground.

name: Unwalled Breath
description: Draw a breath wide as the plateau and bring the user's qi back to full measure.

name: Open Counter
description: Open the body to a strike and let it pass through to the empty ground behind.

name: Boundless Calm
description: Spread a calm with no boundary over a crowd until their quarrel loses its edge.

name: Open Cleanse
description: Open the ground for a poisoned ally and let the taint run out through it.

name: Unwalled Waystrike
description: Strike with no edge to the force so it reaches as far as the foe stands.

name: Boundless Way
description: Walk the Way across the plateau so that every foe on it is calmed and driven from the ground.
